en.headline: Hong Kong non-exchange-traded product sales hit record HK$9.9 trillion in 2025
en.dek: A joint SFC-HKMA survey showed a 63 per cent rise driven by strong demand for fixed-income, currency and commodity products and record market participation.
body: Sales of non-exchange-traded investment products in Hong Kong reached a record HK$9.9 trillion in 2025, up 63 per cent from the previous year, according to the annual joint survey released by the Securities and Futures Commission and the Hong Kong Monetary Authority.

The number of clients who completed at least one such transaction rose 33 per cent to more than 1.6 million, while the number of licensed corporations and registered institutions selling the products increased 9 per cent to 452. Firms with annual transaction volume of HK$1 billion or more grew 27 per cent to 128.

Collective investment schemes accounted for HK$4.1 trillion, or 42 per cent of the total, overtaking structured products for the first time since 2020. Structured products totalled HK$3.9 trillion and debt securities HK$929 billion. Money-market funds dominated the top collective-investment sales reported by large firms.

SFC Executive Director of Intermediaries Mr Keith Lui said the record sales and participation reflected global investor confidence in Hong Kong as an international financial centre and the city’s rising role as a fixed-income, currency and commodity hub.

zh.headline: 去年非交易所買賣投資產品銷售創9.9萬億元新高
zh.dek: 證監會與金管局聯合調查顯示按年急升63%，受惠於固定收益、貨幣及商品產品需求強勁及市場參與度破紀錄。
body: 證監會與金管局發表的年度聯合調查顯示，香港2025年非交易所買賣投資產品銷售達9.9萬億元，創歷史新高，按年上升63%。
完成至少一項相關交易的客戶數目升33%至超過160萬名，從事投資產品銷售的持牌法團及註冊機構數目升9%至452家，當中總交易額達10億元或以上的大型公司數目升27%至128家。
集體投資計劃銷售達4.1萬億元，佔總額42%，自2020年以來首次超越結構性產品。結構性產品銷售為3.9萬億元，債務證券為9290億元。大型公司呈報的首五大集體投資計劃銷售中，貨幣市場基金佔大多數。
證監會中介機構部執行董事葉志衡表示，銷售及市場參與度均創新高，反映全球投資者對香港作為領先國際金融中心的信心，亦凸顯香港發展成為固定收益、貨幣及商品樞紐的地位正不斷提升。
